name: lb2-direct-kimi
description: The lb2-direct baseline with Kimi K2.5 in place of Qwen: the same one call, prompt, context limit (262,144), output budget, reasoning setting and skip policy. The document is still counted with the pinned Qwen tokenizer, as a proxy for Kimi's; a document the provider counts beyond its limit fails as a run error, as with Qwen.
